content.case_type_self_described: slip and fall at residential property

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Hi Niko, this is the intake line at SMD's partner law firm. I understand you'd like to talk about a slip and fall at residential property. Is now still a good time?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, thanks for calling back. So on 2026-03-17 I was walking into the grocery store when slip and fall at residential property happened.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what injuries you've experienced, and whether you've gotten medical treatment?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: I've been having headaches and dizziness. I went to Tucson Mesa Family Practice the next day. They referred me to an imaging center.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Did you exchange information with the other party? Do you know who their insurance is with?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, Coronado Mutual Casualty. The police were also there.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Have you spoken with the insurance company yet?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Not yet, I wanted to talk to a lawyer first.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Got it. One more question — have you worked with another attorney on this matter, or signed anything with another firm?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: No, I went through the bar referral service to find your firm.
